purpose: Static town -> region table behind stobeRegionRouteTownRegions() (lib/region_route.php). Region names are the canonical names of lib/destination_catalog.json. Only towns with a verifiable source are listed; a region with no listed town gets an honest cannot_route_yet.
how_to_extend: Add "<exact in-game town name>": {"region": "<catalog region name>", "source": "<where it was verified>"}. Never guess a town. A native world_towns `region` field will replace this file later.
